scope: One shared frozen current host for all Bend APIs, one shared output runtime for their generated programs. Each compiler retains its own embedded runtime. Pinned TS retains its own compiler and generated runtime. Fresh processes, exact diagnostic/check text and observed program outputs; JS bytes compared only between Bend compilers when requested. Parse/check/emit latencies are cumulative request scopes, not additive phase timings.
cachePolicy: Separate validated Base cache per Bend API is primed before timing. Pinned TS has no equivalent serialized compiler-side Base cache and loads/checks Base in each process. OS caches are not flushed.
orderPolicy: Original variant order in even repetitions; reverse order in odd repetitions. Every pair alternates relative order.
